summary: Candidate 'Client Initialization with Auto-Trace Toggle' is a narrower, implementation-specific variant of the broader 'AgentOps SDK Initialization' skill. Its core responsibility—conditional auto-start of tracing based on auto_start_session flag—is already covered by the SDK initialization workflow. The auto-trace logic and legacy session wrapper handling are specialized details of the 'Auto-start Trace Session Initialization' skill. The candidate should be merged into both parent skills rather than persisted as a separate session_skill, as it represents a sub-workflow of SDK setup and trace initialization, not a distinct capability.
